files.user-maria-activities.md:
---
name: user-maria-activities
description: Maria's volunteering, fitness, family, faith, travel, pets and social life as of August 2023
type: user
---
Maria volunteers at a homeless shelter and keeps fit. As of 17 December 2022 she had just started aerial yoga and enjoys it. On 21 December 2022 she donated her old car to the homeless shelter she volunteers at. As of 9 January 2023 she has become friends with a fellow volunteer. She has a small family; she enjoys time with friends (movies, hiking, game nights at her place). She recently made peach cobbler (Dec 2022).
Update 28 Jan 2023: She volunteered at the shelter during an event for kids around 21 Jan 2023. Her aunt believed in volunteering and helped Maria's family when they were struggling; this inspired her to volunteer. A memorable moment: she comforted a lonely girl (~8) with no family at the event. Maria strongly supports more funding/resources for schools and raising awareness about education.
Update 5 Feb 2023: She did a charity event on Friday 3 Feb 2023, serving meals. She talked with a man named David about his hardship and linked him to a nearby organization offering housing and support for homeless people. She offered to help John with networking and future events.
Update 25 Feb 2023: She took a creative writing class recently and found it enlightening. On 24 Feb 2023 she met Jean at the shelter, a woman who went through divorce, job loss and homelessness yet stays optimistic and grateful; it taught Maria about gratitude and connection. Maria wants to keep working with John to make positive change in the community.
Update 6 Mar 2023: Her grandma passed away in the last week of Feb 2023 (around 27 Feb); Maria is grieving but trying to stay positive. She has siblings and did memory-making activities with them as a kid. She traveled to London, England a few years ago, was captivated by the castles/architecture, and has home decor and a painting inspired by it. She builds trust at the shelter by listening and showing compassion.
Update 2 Apr 2023: She is taking a poetry class to put her feelings into words; it has been a rough but good period. She volunteered together with John last year.
Update 7 Apr 2023: She took part in a 5K charity run for a homeless shelter around 1-2 Apr 2023 (weekend before); found the unity rewarding and it reaffirmed her passion for charity work.
Update 10 Apr 2023: She recently gave a few talks at the shelter and got compliments from other volunteers. She bought a cross necklace to feel closer to her faith. Around 3 Apr 2023 she helped organize a meal for shelter residents. Says shelter people feel like family.
Update 4 May 2023: She cooked dinner with her mom on 3 May 2023; loves banana split sundaes after volunteering. Stays balanced via exercise, music and time with loved ones. Last year (2022) was hard for her; she took a solo trip to Spain, where she tried surfing for the first time (kept falling but persisted); it was transformative.
Update 6 May 2023: She joined a nearby church on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to community and faith; says it's going great. Life has been a bit rough lately but she is reflecting and seeking balance. Charity work feels fulfilling.
Update 20 May 2023: She is planning a ring-toss tournament for the homeless shelter's fundraiser later in May 2023.
Update 25 May 2023: The shelter fundraiser is next week (~first week of June 2023) and includes a chili cook-off (she made a poster); goal is to cover basic needs for the homeless. John offered to spread the word and ask around for volunteers; she wants volunteers.
Update 3 Jun 2023: She just started volunteering at a local dog shelter once a month.
Update 12 Jun 2023: She went camping with friends from church the weekend of 3-4 Jun 2023. She has camped a few times but never mountain climbed. As a kid her family took a road trip to Oregon (hiked to a waterfall and bridge, felt magical). Finds peace in nature, music and alone time; aerial yoga is a favorite, especially upside-down poses.
Update 16 Jun 2023: She joined a gym around 9 Jun 2023 and loves the welcoming atmosphere; goals are getting stronger and building endurance, and she is trying kundalini yoga. Has not tried rock climbing. Has a family beach vacation memory from Florida (colorful sunset, gratitude).
Update 27 Jun 2023: She has been struggling lately but focuses on the positive and leans on friends and family, who she says are her rock. Volunteering at the shelter is her silver lining; a favorite memory is a person at the shelter, sad for months, who laughed when Maria played with the kids.
Update 3 Jul 2023: On 2 Jul 2023 a car ran a red light and hit Maria's car; everyone was okay. She is helping her cousin, who had to leave her home in a hurry, find a new place, and asked John for housing resources/organizations (he offered to look). A shelter resident, Laura, wrote the volunteers a gratitude letter, which inspired her. She met kids at the shelter and shared photos.
Update 5 Jul 2023: Inspired by chatting with people, volunteering and music; takes regular "me-time" walks at a nearby park, which has made a big impact.
Update 7 Jul 2023: Has friends from the gym (had dinner with them 7 Jul 2023). Agreed to join John's community meeting on flood/infrastructure solutions.
Update 17 Jul 2023: Had a picnic with friends from church around 8-9 Jul 2023 (charades, scavenger hunt).
Update 22 Jul 2023: Hiked to a summit with church friends ~15-16 Jul 2023 (felt peace, connection); plans to explore more and volunteer at shelters in Aug 2023; interested in trying new fitness classes; likes baking (cakes).
Update 31 Jul 2023: Around 24 Jul 2023 she dropped off baked goods at the homeless shelter; feels more motivated than ever to help people.
Update 3 Aug 2023: She started shelter volunteering about a year ago (~mid 2022) after seeing a family struggling on the streets; she reached out and asked if they needed volunteers. A resident, Cindy, wrote a gratitude note to volunteers.
Update 5 Aug 2023: On 4 Aug 2023 she did community work with friends from church and found it very rewarding.
Update 9 Aug 2023: In the week before (~2-8 Aug 2023) she volunteered at the shelter and was given a medal in recognition; found it humbling.
Update 11 Aug 2023: She got a puppy named Coco around 28 Jul 2023; it brings her joy, though caring for her is an adjustment.
Update 13 Aug 2023: She adopted a second dog, Shadow, from a shelter around 6 Aug 2023; Shadow is energetic, learning commands and house training, and gets along with her other dog. Maria had no pets growing up.
Update 16 Aug 2023: On Fri 11 Aug 2023 she volunteered at the shelter's front desk; loved seeing residents smile when given food or a bed.
files.project-john-local-politics.md:
---
name: project-john-local-politics
description: Friend John's plan to enter local politics/policymaking (education/infrastructure), blog, service group, food drive, military aptitude test, family, graduation, car trouble, family boot camps, infrastructure community project, veterans petition and march, dog Max's death, possible rescue dog, mountaineering, June 2023 promotion, July 2023 West County flood, veteran hospital visit, new job and yoga studio, fire brigade, military memorial visit, Aug 2023 job loss and tech job lead, veterans 5K charity run, feeling low impact, school mentoring; Maria asked to be kept posted and offered help
type: project
---
Maria's friend John (chatted 17 Dec 2022) is hoping to get into local politics. Focus: improving education and infrastructure, motivated by seeing his neighborhood suffer from poor schools and crumbling infrastructure growing up. Next step: talking to local leaders and organizations for support and ideas. Maria asked him to keep her posted on his campaign. Update 22 Dec 2022: John has been networking with people for input; a conversation with someone sharing stories fired up his passion for improving local education. Maria is supportive and encouraging.
Update 1 Jan 2023: John joined a service-focused online group in late Dec 2022. They have done a food/supplies giveaway at a homeless shelter and a toy drive for kids, and are brainstorming projects for underserved communities (education, mentorship, job training, resume building). John recently failed a military aptitude test and is feeling stressed; Maria offered support.
Update 9 Jan 2023: John has been talking to community leaders and learning neighborhood needs; feels optimistic. He has a community meeting around 16 Jan 2023 on education and infrastructure upgrades. Maria is taking notes on local politics in her notebook and wants to work with him as a team. Also, John had an unexpected incident on his way home in early Jan 2023 (stayed calm, asked for help, got home safe); he likes watching sunsets to calm down.
Update 28 Jan 2023: John attended the community meeting; hearing residents' worries reinforced that upgrades are crucial, especially for kids, and he is upset about the state of education. He has kids of his own. He and Maria agree on fighting for more school funding/resources.
Update 5 Feb 2023: John says he wants to run for office out of a strong urge to serve his country and community. He recently started helping with a community food drive for people who lost jobs (motivated by local unemployment); response and volunteer turnout have been overwhelming. Maria offered to help with networking and future events; John accepted.
Update 25 Feb 2023: John says he is running for office again (after a previous run showed him the impact he can make through politics). Maria congratulated him and wants to keep working together for the community. A colleague, Rob, invited John to a beginner's yoga class.
Update 6 Mar 2023: John retook the military aptitude test in late Feb 2023 with great results and feels drawn to serve his country that way; family and friends are supportive. He has a wife and kids, including a one-year-old son, Kyle; they go to the park a few times a week and enjoy picnics and events (e.g. a violin concert).
Update 2 Apr 2023: John graduated with his degree around 26 Mar 2023. He is now considering a career in policymaking, focused on education and infrastructure; community meetings deepened his understanding of the problems. Maria again offered help; they recalled volunteering together last year.
Update 7 Apr 2023: John started a weekend beginner yoga class with a colleague and does yoga as part of his daily routine; loves it. Around 1-2 Apr 2023 he volunteered at a career fair at a local school, saw how lack of resources hurts kids' dreams, and vowed to keep pushing for them.
Update 10 Apr 2023: John's car broke down Fri 7 Apr 2023 on the way to work; repairs are straining his finances but he is staying positive. He mentioned a road trip last year along the Pacific Northwest coast and national parks.
Update 18 Apr 2023: John is blogging about politics and government, researching education reform and infrastructure policy, and has gotten good feedback. He went to a tech-for-good convention with colleagues in March 2023. He is planning a trip to the East Coast.
Update 4 May 2023: John started family boot camps in April 2023, three times a week; the family has more energy and strength, and the kids are excited about staying active. He says family is the most important thing to him. He also baked apple pie for the kids.
Update 6 May 2023: John decided around 29 Apr 2023 to run for office again despite past losses. A power cut in his area that week highlighted the need for infrastructure upgrades; he also cites pothole-ridden roads and wants better housing/living conditions. He is thinking of starting a community infrastructure project and Maria agreed to work with him to get neighborhood backing; he also wants to improve his old area, West County. He sometimes feels overwhelmed; Maria encourages him.
Update 20 May 2023: John is working on a project supporting military veterans, trying to start a petition (rewarding but stressful). He held a small party on Fri 12 May 2023 where veterans shared stories and made connections. Maria said she'll help with it.
Update 25 May 2023: John is still working on the petition; it's tricky but he is reconnecting with old friends and gaining support. Workmates went on a hiking trip together and motivate him. He offered to help promote Maria's fundraiser.
Update 3 Jun 2023: John's family dog Max, a family member for 10 years, died recently; they are grieving but comforted by memories. John is considering adopting a rescue dog to teach his kids responsibility and compassion. Maria offered help.
Update 12 Jun 2023: Still grieving Max but finding comfort in memories. John went on a mountaineering trip with workmates around 5 Jun 2023 and reached the summit; it cleared his head. He has camped plenty of times. Recent park day with family, kids enjoyed the playground.
Update 16 Jun 2023: John was promoted to assistant manager at work (long awaited, a stepping stone). He has a trophy symbolizing overcoming obstacles (tech, workplace, self-doubt) with family support. Sometimes works from home. He is trying different workout regimes and is interested in rock climbing. Family vacation to California (sunset beach stroll).
Update 27 Jun 2023: John's family went to a live music event around 20 Jun 2023 and had a great time dancing.
Update 3 Jul 2023: John recently took part in a march for veterans' rights, motivated by respect for the military; felt energized about activism. He offered to look for housing resources for Maria's cousin.
Update 5 Jul 2023: John says the campaign feels like an uphill battle and he sometimes doubts he's making a difference, but Maria's support and his family keep him going. He has a daughter, Sara (family trip last year for her birthday). Inspirations: family, exercise, friends. He watches ocean sunsets on walks at least weekly.
Update 7 Jul 2023: A nasty flood hit John's old area (~last week, late Jun/early Jul 2023); poor infrastructure meant many homes were ruined. He is gathering people to discuss solutions and Maria committed to join the meeting and contribute.
Update 17 Jul 2023: John visited a veterans' hospital around 10 Jul 2023 and met veterans, including elderly Samuel; it reminded him why he wanted to join the military. He is part of an organization he describes as family. Saw arts and crafts/games at a community event in June 2023 and plans similar game activities for his kids.
Update 22 Jul 2023: John says he is enjoying a new job with an encouraging team. He often goes to a yoga studio offering yoga, kickboxing and circuit training; he has also tried weight training and offered Maria advice on starting classes.
Update 31 Jul 2023: John recently joined a fire-fighting brigade (inspired by Maria's shelter work). Training was intense; first call-out was Sun 30 Jul 2023, where the team saved a family from a burning building. He says the team feels like family and the bond is like his military days.
Update 3 Aug 2023: John asked family and friends to join the virtual support group he's in, to advocate for the military; many joined. Around late Jul 2023 he took his kids to a military memorial; they were awestruck and humbled.
Update 5 Aug 2023: John lost his job at a mechanical engineering company (it went under). He had been eyeing the tech industry and may have found a job at a tech company where his mechanical skills fit their hardware team; he sees it as a possible positive change. He hasn't had much time to volunteer lately, but last year (2022) helped renovate a rundown community center in his hometown.
Update 9 Aug 2023: John organized a neighborhood 5K charity run around 5-6 Aug 2023 to raise funds for veterans and their families; it took work (sponsors were the hardest part, plus city coordination) but had great turnout. He has also done an event with a local organization helping domestic abuse victims, raising awareness and funds.
Update 11 Aug 2023: John still thinks about Max (best memory: camping trip summer 2022, hiking and swimming). He is going through tough times, feeling he isn't making enough impact and stuck; plans to list and contact local organizations/volunteer programs matching his beliefs. Maria encouraged him.
Update 13 Aug 2023: John is now volunteering as a mentor at a local school (found it rewarding; students' confidence and skills improving). He wants to look into shelters for a new dog. Family (wife and kids) enjoy hikes, park, picnics, board games and movie nights.
Other John details: does kickboxing and taekwondo, returned from a family road trip on 16 Dec 2022; close with his family (enjoys playground outings, making pizza together, beach outings); had a film camera as a kid and took beach pics; had a childhood doll that comforted him.
